verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents deploying full-stack apps with `fly launch` as a managed platform, and offers fast-booting Machines that scale out, plus Sprites that sleep until needed. However, it never documents a serverless-functions product, and its workloads are VMs that users configure, scale and restart, so 'no servers to manage' is only partly met. Community reports of flaky deploys concern reliability rather than refuting the capability, so they lower confidence but do not make this disputed. Missing for 10: an explicit serverless-functions offering, documented zero-server-management (fully managed autoscaling) semantics, and independent corroboration that deploys work reliably.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps with no servers to manage

citations.quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
Fly.io is a global public cloud for running full-stack and AI applications.
Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second, run close to your users, and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives.
Give it a Sprite that sleeps until it's needed and wakes up remembering everything.
